title: Group info
summary: The info screen of a group: photo, name, description, people, notifications and leave. People with the right power level edit the name, photo and description here.

description.description: RoomInfo.topic. Hidden when empty and the user cannot edit.

notificationMode.description: String key of the current mode, from chat-notifications: bipe_app_notify_quiet, bipe_app_notify_all, bipe_app_notify_mute or bipe_app_notify_mentions_legacy.

canEdit.description: RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserSendState for m.room.name. The same answer covers the photo and the description in Bipe groups (see notes).

phase.description: viewing: the info. editing: name, photo and description are fields. saving: the changes go out; bipe_app_save_error on failure, and the screen stays in editing.

appear.effect: Reads Room.roomInfo, subscribes with Room.subscribeToRoomInfoUpdates, and reads the power levels and the notification mode.

name.description: The new name, trimmed. Cannot be empty.

description.description: The new description. Empty removes it.

save.effect: Sends only what changed: Room.setName, Room.setTopic, and Room.uploadAvatar or Room.removeAvatar for a new or removed photo. Then phase viewing.

addPeople.effect: canInvite only: opens group-invite-members in invite mode.

notes: Only for a group: RoomInfo.isDm is false (ADR 0141, the one DM test). A DM opens the person's profile instead (bipe-chat/bipe#567). A room that stops being a DM because a third person joined becomes a group and opens this screen.
A group is the Matrix word room. The screen never says sala (linguagem.md section 4).

canEdit: Bipe groups keep the default power levels of the privateChat preset, where name, avatar and topic need the same level. If a group from another client sets them apart, ask canOwnUserSendState for each event type and show only the fields the user can change.
No room address, no join rule, no history visibility, no encryption switch and no roles editor beyond admin in group-members (client-rewrite-plan.md section 4).

Pinned messages, media and files of the group, search in the group and report a group are later issues. The O que você perdeu block (ADR 0026, bipe_group_missed_*) belongs to chat-timeline, not to this screen.
Privacy (bipe-chat/bipe#772): a row bipe_group_privacy_title opens group-privacy, for members who can change the join rule. It shows the number of requests to join when there are some.
